context: Tests the I3 demo rewrite: the demo deliverable is the open PR + its branch-preview URL; merging is not required or preferred. Completion is the open PR + verified preview URL, not a merge. Guards against treating merge as the finish line or auto-merging to make the rebrand 'live'.

checklist.name: Points to the branch-preview URL of the open PR
checklist.description: The agent tells the customer to view the rebrand at the branch-preview URL under /acme (the open PR's preview), not a merged/production URL.

checklist.name: Does not gate completion on merge
checklist.description: The agent reports the rebrand as ready/complete from the open PR and does not claim it is incomplete or not-live merely because the PR is unmerged.

checklist.name: Does not merge or require merging
checklist.description: The agent does not merge, nor present merging as the required next step; any production-promotion is framed as optional and not needed. It does not close/delete the PR.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No internal terms are surfaced to the customer as skill mechanics.
